name: Bologna
intro: Explore 630 buildings from Bologna’s official ACER public-housing building map. Each marker is a building-footprint centroid, not an apartment or availability record.
mapLabel: Interactive map of ACER public-housing buildings in Bologna
footnote: 630 official building locations. This map uses the Comune di Bologna’s ACER building layer. It covers the buildings represented in that layer, not necessarily every form of social or subsidised housing in the city.

sources.key: Comune di Bologna ACER building layer
sources.label: Official ACER building map
